race.comment: REGAL GALA (1) has been in fine form and took full advantage of starting off the pegs to record a well-deserved win last start over 2240m at Melton, getting home by 5 metres after taking control early in proceedings. That added to a string of top-two results that included a second in the Vicbred Final prior. Looks tough to beat. PHOENIX REX (5) was disappointing last start when fifth over 2240m at Melton after four wins and one minor placings from his first five starts. This should be an easier assignment so he is a major player. KYVALLEY DIXON (6) didn't do a bad job when fourth over 2240m at Melton last time out and win the fillies' Vicbred final prior. Contender. MAJARO GIRL (8) is in the mix following a respectable second at her most recent appearance at Melton.
